# RTF to PDF

> Free Chrome extension that converts RTF files to PDF entirely in the browser: no uploads, no accounts, works offline. Conversion is one click and runs on the user's device — because the file never leaves it, the output keeps the document's exact fonts, colors, tables and selectable text instead of being re-processed by a website. This website is the extension's documentation and home page, not an online converter.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rtf2pdf.app/): product overview, features, privacy highlights, FAQ
- [Welcome / onboarding](https://rtf2pdf.app/welcome.html): how to pin the extension to the toolbar and choose a usage mode
- [Privacy policy](https://rtf2pdf.app/privacy.html): what data is and is not collected
- [Install page (Chrome Web Store)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rtf-to-pdf/pobhkhkiocaphogjeglealncldfdcall): free install, Chromium desktop browsers

## Key facts

- Input format: `.rtf` only (not `.doc`/`.docx`).
- Output: PDF with selectable, copyable text; fonts, colors, tables and images preserved.
- Conversion is local: files never leave the device; works offline after install — nothing is uploaded or re-processed on a server.
- Multiple files can be queued; results download separately or as one ZIP archive.
- Price: free, no watermarks or file limits, no account needed.
- Contact: saiph.forge@gmail.com
